name: Network Matrices
summary: Builds structural network adjacency matrices (streamline count, density, length and optional tensor-based edge weights and tract profiles) from a tractogram and a volumetric parcellation with the FiNE MATLAB tool.
description: Dilates the parcellation labels into white matter within the brain mask, assigns streamlines to node pairs and writes adjacency matrices of streamline count, density, length and length-corrected density, plus network statistics. Optionally adds mean/std FA, MD, AD or RD per edge, tract profiles along edges, and edge curvature and torsion. Use it to build connectomes for network analysis; tract profiles need more memory and runtime. Tractogram, parcellation, mask and tensor maps must be in the same space.

inputs.description: The nodes to build the networks
The streamlines to create the edges
You can request average microstructure properties (FA/MD/AD/RD) or tract profiles for edge weights.

Brain mask used to inflate the label slightly into the white matter so that we can capture more fibers that don't quite enter the gray matter volume. You can feed the mask output from Multi-atlas transfer tool App, or run FSL Brain extraction App. The mask should not include the ventricle.

outputs.description: Directory of CSV adjacency matrices (count, density, length, denlen, optional *_mean/*_std), optional tract profiles (*_tp.csv, curv.csv, tors.csv), node centres, network stats.json and MATLAB .mat objects of edges, ROIs and matrices.

parameters.description: The number of voxels to dilate the labels into white matter.
Optionally select which microstructure measure to summarize
Compute curvature and torsion of edges
Compute mean / std of optional tensor property
Compute tract profile of optional tensor property (requires more memory and runtime)
The number of points to re-sample to for computing edge curves and tract profiles

citations.text: Avesani P, McPherson B, Hayashi S, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).

failure_modes.fix: The network build did not produce pconn.mat; check the inputs and, for tract profiles, the memory available.
